name: Echigo Sanzan Tadami Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 越後三山只見国定公園
aliases: 越後三山只見国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of the Echigo mountains and the Tadami river gorge on the Niigata-Fukushima border, with Okutadami dam lake and deep snow-country landscapes.
notes: Managed by Niigata/Fukushima. The Kanetsu expressway and Okutadami access roads reach the park.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
